name: Análisis de Expresiones Temporales
description: Analiza expresiones temporales and verb tense consistency para detectar generado por IA text through temporal reasoning failures.
useCase: Detección de texto IA mediante marcadores temporales inconsistentes y cambios de tiempo verbal
mechanism: Extrae expresiones temporales (dates, durations, relative time references like 'recently', 'last year') and maps verb tenses throughout the text. Analiza temporal coherencia by checking for logical consistency entre temporal markers and verb tenses dentro de and a través de paragraphs. generado por IA text sometimes produces temporal inconsistencias—mixing past and present references without clear discourse signals, or generating implausible temporal sequences.
accuracy: Moderada - 69-79% on narrative and news text
source: Verhagen, M. et al. (2007) - SemEval-2007 Task 15: TempEval Temporal Relation Identification, SemEval
algorithm: Temporal Expression Extraction + Tense Chain Analysis + Temporal Coherence Scoring
parameters: Extraction: rule-based + neural, Tense tracking: per-clause, Coherence: temporal graph consistency, Expression types: DATE/TIME/DURATION/SET
strengths:
• Captures temporal reasoning failures specific to AI
• Effective on narrative and news domains
• Detecta subtle logical inconsistencias
• Complements semantic-level análisis
limitations:
• Complex to implement reliably
• Some texts intentionally use temporal shifts (flashbacks)
• Modern LLMs have improved temporal reasoning
• Language-specific temporal expression patrones

references.title: Verhagen, M. et al. (2007). SemEval-2007 Task 15: TempEval Temporal Relation Identification. SemEval.
Ning, Q. et al. (2019). An Improved Neural Baseline for Temporal Relation Extraction. NAACL.
Krishna, K. et al. (2024). Paraphrasing Evades Detectors of AI-Generated Text. NAACL.
